note: Archive ids for builds absent from Mojang's manifest. Only pre-classic/classic/indev/infdev/alpha/beta and 1.0.0 release candidates are listed; weekly snapshots, pre-release and other release variants are skipped because the archive stores them as suffix variants of builds that already exist. These builds have no Mojang metadata and cannot be installed automatically.
downloadNote: Each archived build is fetched from the Betacraft archive: <id>.info holds the real client jar URL.
